title: Derived adjunctions under compatible changes of ring sheaves
statement:
Let $u:U\to V$ be a morphism of schemes with small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For $T=U,V$, let $R_T,S_T$ be sheaves of commutative rings on $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$ and $a_T:R_T\to S_T$ ring maps. Specify isomorphisms $c_R:u^{-1}R_V\xrightarrow{\sim}R_U$ and $c_S:u^{-1}S_V\xrightarrow{\sim}S_U$ satisfying $a_Uc_R=c_Su^{-1}a_V$. Write $D(R_T)=D(\operatorname{Mod}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},R_T))$ and $D(S_T)=D(\operatorname{Mod}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},S_T))$. Use these ordinary unbounded module derived categories and adjunctions $L_R=Lu_R^*\dashv R_R=Ru_{*,R}$ and $L_S=Lu_S^*\dashv R_S=Ru_{*,S}$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Let $r_T:D(S_T)\to D(R_T)$ be termwise restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], which is exact. Then $r_T$ reflects isomorphisms, and there are canonical natural isomorphisms
$$b:r_UL_S\xrightarrow{\sim}L_Rr_V,\qquad d:r_VR_S\xrightarrow{\sim}R_Rr_U.$$
The first comparison is induced by the identified-coefficient inverse image on module sheaves. The second is the derived direct-image comparison induced by the two equal composites of ringed-topos morphisms $(U,S_U)\to(V,R_V)$ through $(U,R_U)$ and through $(V,S_V)$. These comparisons respect the derived adjunctions in the following precise sense: for $M\in D(S_V)$, $N\in D(S_U)$ and $t:L_SM\to N$ with adjunct $t^\sharp:M\to R_SN$, the adjunct of $r_U(t)\circ b_M^{-1}:L_Rr_VM\to r_UN$ is $d_N\circ r_V(t^\sharp):r_VM\to R_Rr_UN$.

proof.text: Restriction is exact and conservative before deriving; the module and cohomology arguments give the two reflected-isomorphism clauses in the final theorem.
The identified-coefficient inverse-image mate is constructed termwise and descended through localization, giving the canonical derived pullback comparison b.

The compatible coefficient square identifies the two ringed-topos composites. The general derived direct-image composition theorem yields the normalized comparison existence theorem recorded as lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction-existence.

The normalization equation determines the comparison uniquely: apply derived_comp_ext to the direct image over S and exact restriction over V, then cancel the common unit and factor maps. This proves the parent existsUnique theorem from the existence split.
The final adjunct equation follows by the mate identity for the derived adjunctions after substituting the canonical pullback and direct-image comparisons.
